from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
    mh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    mw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - mh + 1):
        for c in range(w - mw + 1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = marker
    return out
'''
